briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 multimodal lead sparks fresh compute arms race with xAI and DeepSeek

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue aggressive model releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies on autonomous agents. Compute shortages persist despite massive new data center announcements. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain critical bottlenecks in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 achieving new SOTA on multimodal reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3.0 Pro both launched this month with enhanced agentic capabilities. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while xAI and DeepSeek accelerated their next training runs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New EU AI Office guidance mandates red-teaming for frontier models. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level and has been referenced in automotive and BCI security discussions.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $15B hyperscale expansion in Texas and Arizona. NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units monthly. TSMC reports AI chip orders up 68% YoY with new 2nm capacity allocated to OpenAI and Google.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialect negotiation become mandatory infrastructure before the first AGI-scale deployment?
